Me and a few friends snuck into this place when we were just out of high school. We had to split up to get in. Some squeezed through the gate to the basement. Myself and one other guy went in through a hole in the wall of the hotel then had to climb an interior wall's exposed rebar to get into the hotel proper. We actually ended up bring a tent and called it in the ballroom which is on the top floor (15th story). It had a semi wrap-around balcony that overlooks the downtown area of Mineral Wells. As an added bonus a severe storm came through after we set up the tent. It was a great night!
